title: ProjectedCashResponse
description: An account's settled cash baseline plus its projected cash timeline.

settled_cash.description: The account's current settled cash balance, the baseline the projection starts from.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code for every amount in the response.

projections.description:
Cash events in date order. Empty for an account with no holds, no
committed cash raises, no unsettled trades, and no upcoming
cashflows.

DecimalString.title: DecimalString
DecimalString.description: An exact decimal amount, serialized as a string to preserve precision.

ProjectedCashProjection.description: A single cash event on the projected-cash timeline.

type.description:
The kind of cash event:

- `pending`: committed cash whose instrument and side are not
  known. Either a live hold (for example an activated cash raise),
  or, only for organizations where committed cash-raise projection
  is enabled, a cash raise that is committed but not yet activated,
  dated on the day its hold will be placed. Both carry
  `holder_type: cash_raise`; a client that treats them alike sees
  the same cash reduction before and after activation.
- `pending_buy` / `pending_sell` — an executed-but-unsettled trade on
  its trade date, or a live order hold. The amount lands in the
  unsettled bucket.
- `buy` / `sell` — the settled leg of the same trade on its settlement
  date, moving the amount from unsettled into settled. Does not change
  `running_total`.
- `coupon` — a bond coupon payment.
- `maturity` — a bond principal repayment.
- `dividend` — a dividend payment. Only present for organizations
  where dividend projection is enabled.

reason.description:
Human-readable description of the event, intended for display. Where
the security is known this is its description (for example
`T 4.5% 05/12/31` for a bond, `AAPL` for an equity). Free text — do
not parse it; use `type`, `holder_type`, and `instrument_id` to
classify a row.

instrument_id.description:
The security this event relates to, when known. Always check for null
before using it:

- Null on holds that do not identify an instrument.
- Usually populated on coupon, maturity, and dividend rows, but null
  when the upstream cashflow data carries no per-instrument
  attribution. The row's date and amount are still accurate; only the
  security is unattributed.

side.description:
Trade direction on trade-derived rows. Null on instrumentless commitments and on
coupon, maturity, and dividend rows — which is the majority of rows.

holder_type.description:
Present only on rows where something holds or has committed the
cash. Null on every other row; use this to distinguish commitments
from pending trade legs.

- `order` / `allocation` — a buying-power hold keyed by order or allocation.
- `cash_raise`: a cash raise before or after activation.
- `sleeve_realignment` — a sleeve realignment funding its target sleeves.

holder_id.description: Identifier of the entity responsible for a commitment. Null on every other row.

date.description:
The date this event lands on the timeline, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Live holds
are dated today. A cash raise awaiting activation is dated on the
day it is scheduled to activate, which can be months out for a
recurring schedule. A raise with no scheduled activation, such as one
waiting on a manual activation, is dated on its due date instead,
the only day it commits to. Either date, once past, lands on today.
Trade legs are dated on their trade and settlement dates; cashflows
on their payment date.

amount.description: The signed amount of this event. Negative reduces cash.

unsettled.description: Running unsettled-cash balance after this event is applied.

settled.description: Running settled-cash balance after this event is applied, starting from `settled_cash`.

running_total.description:
Projected total cash as of this row's date. Always the sum of
`unsettled` and `settled`.
